title: WALI VESA Mounting Plate for WALI Monitor Mounting System, VESA Compatible 75 by 75 mm and 100 by 100 mm (VES01), Black

reviews.title: Cumple justo con lo esperado.
reviews.body: El artículo cumple con lo esperado, hasta ahora no hay signos de desgaste, o ruptura. Tengo un monitor de 27 pulgadas sobre esta base.
reviews.author: G. P. Lizarraga

reviews.title: WALI Products are always solid!
reviews.body: The WALI Mounting Plate for the WALI Monitor Mounting System is outstanding! It offers incredible stability and versatility, making it a perfect addition to my setup. Installation was a breeze, and the quality of the materials is top-notch. This mounting plate has significantly improved my workspace, providing a secure and adjustable solution for my monitors. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and efficient mounting system!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 14 January 2025
reviews.author: Ric Rodrigues

reviews.title: Stand
reviews.body: Good product, wall mount, design, fit, ease of installation, tilt angle sturdine
reviews.author: Bhavesh

features: Only for: Most WALI desk monitor mount and stand with 1.375” (3.5cm) diameter center pole. Fit one monitor up to 27”, 22 lbs and Mounting Holes size 75x75mm and 100x100mm
Design: The high-grade 2.5” mounting arm with fully adjustable, allow +/- 45° tilt, +/- 90° swivel to change reading angles and 360° rotate from landscape to portrait mode
Dynamic: Monitor arm is easily adjustable, allowing to work in a more comfortable and ergonomically correct position to reduce neck and eyestrain
Package Includes: WALI 2.5” Single Fully Adjustable Arm x 1, Mounting Plate x 1, Mounting Hardware Kit x 1, experienced and friendly US based customer support available to assist 7 days a week
